era.title: Galactic Coexistence
era.subtitle: Humanity joins a larger cosmic community of intelligence
era.description: This era marks humanity's integration into a broader cosmic civilization. Intelligence is recognized across biological, artificial, planetary, and cosmic forms. Galactic knowledge networks, black hole energy harvesting, intergalactic exploration, shared human-AI-alien societies, and new forms of consciousness redefine civilization itself. Humanity's story becomes one chapter in a much larger cosmic history.
